name: RSI Oversold + EMA Trend
idea_text: RSI oversold buy with EMA trend filter — buy when RSI(14) < 30 and price is above EMA(50), sell when RSI > 70 and price is below EMA(50)

name: MACD Crossover
idea_text: MACD bullish crossover above zero line — buy when MACD line crosses above signal line, sell on the opposite crossover

name: Bollinger Mean Reversion
idea_text: Bollinger Band mean reversion — buy when price closes below the lower band, sell when price closes above the upper band
